title: Tartare sauce
preamble:
200ml/7fl oz mayonnaise

3 tbsp capers, drained and chopped

3 tbsp gherkins, drained and chopped

1 small shallot, finely chopped

squeeze of lemon juice
ingredients: flaked sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
method: Mix together all of the ingredients in a small bowl and serve straight away or store in the fridge until needed.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
